verdict.rationale: Docs mention automating the tailnet via infrastructure-as-code, webhooks, and other integrations, and admin tasks like inviting/managing users are documented, suggesting some UI actions have API/CLI equivalents. However there is no explicit API reference or documentation claiming full UI-API parity, and a probe for an OpenAPI/swagger spec returned 404s across all standard paths. missing for 10: explicit API reference documentation, evidence of full UI-API feature parity, working OpenAPI/swagger spec discovery.
